Events

Manage separate events on this device. Each event keeps its own submissions, schedule, registration draft and recovery copy.

Add Event

Keep completed events here, or use Save File to download a backup before deleting. Restore Saved Event adds a saved program without replacing other events.

Event Setup

Combined event: with wing bands required, WB filled means Stag and blank means Cock. With wing bands not required, select Cock or Stag for each bird. Matching always keeps the types separate.

Stags-only: required means every bird needs WB. Combined events: required uses WB to identify Stags; leave WB blank for Cocks. Not required shows a Cock / Stag selector.

Gram events have a fixed 35g maximum weight difference.

Changing settings after registration requires rechecking entries and regenerating matches.

All accepted Stag band types may face each other.

Save and Restore Program

Download a backup file to keep a copy outside this browser. Restore it to return to the saved program. An automatic recovery copy is also kept before confirmed deletions or schedule resets.

Register One Entry

Collect on another phone, then return its submission QR or file to this device for review and numbering.

Photo OCR is experimental and requires internet. Use one entry per photo, labeled Entry name, Entry number, Owner, Gaffer and No Fight, followed by a Bird / LB / WB / WT table, with an optional Special Request column at the end. OCR fills a draft for you to review; handwriting may be misread.

No photo selected.

For photos received through messages, save the image to Photos first, then choose it here.

OCR raw text (for reference)
Use the same owner name for all their entries. Suggestions appear after saving.
Manual No Fight: maximum 2 entries. Entries with the same owner never face each other. Each distinct owner counts as one gaffer group, regardless of their number of entries. A gaffer with up to 3 owner groups cannot face their own groups. With 4 or more owner groups, same-gaffer matches across different owners are considered only to match additional birds.
Bird details
LB may be added by the coordinator later. If entered, it must be unique. Event settings decide whether LB is required before matching.
Weights start at 0-0 (not weighed). Weigh every bird and enter its weight before saving or matching. Provided leg bands must be unique across this event; letter case, spaces, punctuation, and leading zeros do not make a different number.
Check OCR against your photo
Verify entry details, every LB, WB, weight and bird type. OCR can return a valid but incorrect number; compare every weight digit with the photo. A missed WB can incorrectly show a Stag as a Cock. Verify each detected special request; select unclear requests manually.
All Submissions
Compare smaller weight gaps with fewer repeated opponents. Both options keep as many birds matched as possible and respect your event limits. Review and select an option before approval.

Official Fight Schedule
Shareable guide: Export or print the approved schedule. Live public-link hosting is not configured in this local test.
